title: Analytical Library
bodyHtml:
The goal of the PanKbase Analytical Library is to provide multiple different interfaces to analysis tools that accommodate user communities across diverse levels of expertise and desired customization. The analytical library is currently under development.

What analyses will the library contain?

The analytical library will consist of both tools used to perform processing and quality control of data, as well as tools to perform downstream analysis, integration, and advanced modeling of data.

How will analyses be provided to users?

Analysis tools will be provided in multiple different interfaces:

  • Custom web interfaces – for users who want highly structured interfaces guiding them step-by-step through the analyses
  • Cloud-based workspaces – for users who want to utilize external computing platforms to run analyses, including the potential to incorporate restricted access or other external datasets
  • Customizable code – for users who want to download code directly to run themselves and/or to modify the code to tailor their specific needs
